name: Spring Autumn Cicada
global_effects: Free [Rank Six Gu Immortal] appears <upon losing a [{post-[Rank Five era]} {non-[Advancing]}] unit> <if [Spring Autumn Cicada] is constructed> <with [50]% chance>
pedia: Spring Autumn Cicada (春秋蝉), rank six, time path: Red Lotus's vital Gu. When its owner loses an immortal, the will may return up the river of time: half the time a new Gu Immortal appears (without a blessed land).
pedia_id: Jangkrik Musim Semi Gugur (春秋蝉), tingkat enam, jalur waktu: Gu vital Teratai Merah. Saat pemiliknya kehilangan seorang abadi, kehendaknya bisa kembali menyusuri sungai waktu: separuh kemungkinan muncul Gu Abadi baru (tanpa tanah berkah).

name: Fixed Immortal Travel
pedia: Fixed Immortal Travel (定仙游), rank six, space path: carries its holder to any place it remembers. Your immortals gain 1 movement.
pedia_id: Perjalanan Abadi Tetap (定仙游), tingkat enam, jalur ruang: membawa pemegangnya ke tempat mana pun yang ia ingat. Para abadi Anda mendapat 1 gerak.

name: Man as Before
effects: [+20] HP when healing <for [post-[Rank Five era]] units>
pedia: Man as Before (人如故), rank six, time path: returns a body to an earlier moment. Your immortals heal 20 more HP a turn.
pedia_id: Manusia Seperti Dulu (人如故), tingkat enam, jalur waktu: mengembalikan tubuh ke saat sebelumnya. Para abadi Anda pulih 20 HP lebih banyak per giliran.

name: Unravel Mystery
pedia: Unravel Mystery (解谜), rank six, wisdom path: solves trials and puzzles. +15% Science in all cities.
pedia_id: Mengurai Misteri (解谜), tingkat enam, jalur kebijaksanaan: memecahkan ujian dan teka-teki. +15% Sains di semua kota.

name: Connect Luck
global_effects: Free [Rank Six Gu Immortal] appears <upon losing a [{post-[Rank Five era]} {non-[Advancing]}] unit> <if [Connect Luck] is constructed> <if [Spring Autumn Cicada] is constructed> <with [25]% chance>
pedia: Connect Luck (连运), rank six, luck path: links one's luck to others'. Your immortals fight 10% harder, and with Spring Autumn Cicada a fallen immortal returns more often.
pedia_id: Sambung Keberuntungan (连运), tingkat enam, jalur keberuntungan: menautkan keberuntungan seseorang dengan orang lain. Para abadi Anda bertarung 10% lebih kuat, dan bersama Jangkrik Musim Semi Gugur abadi yang gugur lebih sering kembali.

name: Self Strength
pedia: Self Strength (我力), rank six, strength path: the core of Myriad Self. Every strength-path unit you own fights 15% harder.
pedia_id: Kekuatan Diri (我力), tingkat enam, jalur kekuatan: inti dari Sepuluh Ribu Diri. Setiap unit jalur kekuatan milik Anda bertarung 15% lebih kuat.

name: Woman's Heart
pedia: Woman's Heart (妇人心), rank six, poison path. Your units fight 20% harder against wounded units.
pedia_id: Hati Wanita (妇人心), tingkat enam, jalur racun. Unit Anda bertarung 20% lebih kuat melawan unit yang terluka.

name: Bone Spike
pedia: Bone Spike (骨刺), rank six, bone path. Your immortals defend 20% harder.
pedia_id: Duri Tulang (骨刺), tingkat enam, jalur tulang. Para abadi Anda bertahan 20% lebih kuat.

name: Star Eyes
pedia: Star Eyes (星眸), rank six, star path: one of the immortal Gu in Fang Yuan's hands. Your immortals see 2 tiles farther.
pedia_id: Mata Bintang (星眸), tingkat enam, jalur bintang: salah satu Gu abadi di tangan Fang Yuan. Para abadi Anda melihat 2 petak lebih jauh.

name: Divert Disaster
pedia: Divert Disaster (排难), rank six, luck path: weakens or turns aside calamities. Its owner's immortals may divert every earthly calamity and heavenly tribulation at no cost.
pedia_id: Alihkan Bencana (排难), tingkat enam, jalur keberuntungan: melemahkan atau membelokkan bencana. Para abadi pemiliknya dapat mengalihkan setiap bencana bumi dan kesengsaraan langit tanpa biaya.

name: Dragon Strength
pedia: Dragon Strength (龙力), rank seven, strength path: permanent dragon-grade strength. Strength-path units fight 20% harder.
pedia_id: Kekuatan Naga (龙力), tingkat tujuh, jalur kekuatan: kekuatan tingkat naga yang permanen. Unit jalur kekuatan bertarung 20% lebih kuat.

name: Year Gu
effects: Instantly provides [1] [Lifespan Gu] <upon turn start> <every [3] turns>
pedia: Year Gu (年蛊), rank seven, time path: stored years. A Lifespan Gu every three turns.
pedia_id: Gu Tahun (年蛊), tingkat tujuh, jalur waktu: tahun yang tersimpan. Satu Gu Umur tiap tiga giliran.

name: Formation Flag
effects: [+15]% Strength <when adjacent to a [Military] unit> <for [Military] units>
pedia: Formation Flag (阵旗), rank seven, formation path: stores a whole formation and plants it elsewhere. Military units fight 15% harder beside another.
pedia_id: Bendera Formasi (阵旗), tingkat tujuh, jalur formasi: menyimpan seluruh formasi dan menancapkannya di tempat lain. Unit militer bertarung 15% lebih kuat di samping unit lain.

name: Divination Tortoise Shell
pedia: Divination Tortoise Shell (卜卦龟背), rank seven, wisdom path: blocks every deduction about its owner. Heaven's Will cannot find its clan; +10% science.
pedia_id: Cangkang Kura-kura Ramalan (卜卦龟背), tingkat tujuh, jalur kebijaksanaan: menghalangi setiap deduksi tentang pemiliknya. Kehendak Langit tidak bisa menemukan klannya; +10% sains.

name: Dragon Centipede
pedia: Dragon Centipede (龙蜈), rank seven, sword path: the world's only one, a wild Gu that hunts ancient desolate beasts. +30% strength against beasts.
pedia_id: Kelabang Naga (龙蜈), tingkat tujuh, jalur pedang: satu-satunya di dunia, Gu liar yang memburu binatang buas purba kuno. +30% kekuatan melawan binatang.

name: Reputation Restriction
effects: Earn [20]% of killed [Beast] unit's [Cost] as [Immortal Materials]

name: Calamity Beckoning
pedia: Calamity Beckoning (招灾), rank seven, luck path: draws calamities onto oneself. Its owner's immortals may beckon an earthly calamity to the land's edge and keep what it leaves (10 immortal materials).
pedia_id: Pemanggil Bencana (招灾), tingkat tujuh, jalur keberuntungan: menarik bencana ke diri sendiri. Para abadi pemiliknya dapat memanggil bencana bumi ke tepi tanah dan menyimpan sisanya (10 bahan abadi).

name: Change Soul
effects: [+20]% XP gained from combat <for [post-[Rank Five era]] units>
pedia: Change Soul (换魂), rank seven, soul path. Your immortals gain 20% more XP in battle.
pedia_id: Ganti Jiwa (换魂), tingkat tujuh, jalur jiwa. Para abadi Anda mendapat 20% XP lebih banyak dalam pertempuran.

name: Dragon Breath
pedia: Dragon Breath (龙息), rank seven, transformation path. Your immortals attack 20% harder.
pedia_id: Napas Naga (龙息), tingkat tujuh, jalur transformasi. Para abadi Anda menyerang 20% lebih kuat.

name: Dream Token
pedia: Dream Token (如梦令), rank eight, dream path: enslaves even rank eights through their dreams. +20% strength against immortals.
pedia_id: Titah Mimpi (如梦令), tingkat delapan, jalur mimpi: memperbudak bahkan tingkat delapan lewat mimpi mereka. +20% kekuatan melawan para abadi.

name: Soul Beast Token
pedia: Soul Beast Token (魂兽令), rank eight, enslavement path: commands soul beasts. Four units cost no upkeep.
pedia_id: Titah Binatang Jiwa (魂兽令), tingkat delapan, jalur perbudakan: memerintah binatang jiwa. Empat unit tanpa biaya pemeliharaan.

name: Treasure Light Gu
pedia: Treasure Light Gu (宝光蛊), rank eight, light path: the light that prices goods at Treasure Yellow Heaven. +10% stones, and a better bargain in the market.
pedia_id: Gu Cahaya Pusaka (宝光蛊), tingkat delapan, jalur cahaya: cahaya yang menaksir barang di Langit Kuning Harta. +10% batu, dan tawaran lebih baik di pasar.

name: Advance Refinement Gu
effects: [+30]% Production when constructing [Immortal Gu] wonders [in all cities]

pedia: Steal Life (偷生), rank eight, theft path: Thieving Heaven's first Gu. An immortal that kills heals 25 HP.
pedia_id: Curi Nyawa (偷生), tingkat delapan, jalur pencurian: Gu pertama Pencuri Langit. Abadi yang membunuh pulih 25 HP.

name: Human Qi Immortal Gu

pedia_id: Gu Abadi Qi Manusia (人气仙蛊), tingkat delapan, jalur qi: salah satu dari tiga qi sebagai Gu. 3 qi manusia per giliran.

name: Wisdom Gu

pedia: Wisdom Gu (智慧蛊), rank nine, wisdom path: its light speeds every deduction, at a cost in lifespan; second only to Fate Gu in the Heavenly Court's eyes. +30% science; burns a Lifespan Gu every five turns.

name: Derivation Gu
effects: [+30]% Production when constructing [All] buildings [in all cities]
pedia: Derivation Gu (衍化蛊), rank nine, rule path: derives new results from given inputs, the core of a Heavenly Court formation. Buildings are built 30% faster.
pedia_id: Gu Derivasi (衍化蛊), tingkat sembilan, jalur aturan: menurunkan hasil baru dari masukan yang ada, inti sebuah formasi Istana Langit. Bangunan dibangun 30% lebih cepat.
